notes.title: Living Dead Girl - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Our Halloween DLC, Living Dead Girl, is out now! 

This is a small, silly, spooky tale from us to anyone who missed the residents of Lunaris. Get the gang back together to help a ghoul in need, humble Finn, and maybe kiss a ghost.

You may have noticed if you tried to launch the game yesterday that we're having some issues, so please accept our sincere apologies for that, and rest assured we've been yelling at Steam to try and get a fix sorted, however they, unfortunately, do not offer support on weekends so we've been left trying to find a solution ourselves until (hopefully) Monday. 

The DLC is supposed to install as a separate game/app in your Steam library underneath the base game, but this is not currently happening for us. In order to play the game until Steam assists us with this error, please do the following; 

- Right-click on the WTNC base game in your Steam library
- Navigate to 'Properties' 
- Navigate to the DLC tab
- Tick the box next to Living Dead Girl 



The DLC will then proceed to download and you can launch it via either the WTNC base game in your library or via the store page by clicking 'Play Now.' 

If you wish to then play the main base game after playing Living Dead Girl (before we get this issue fixed), you just need to untick that same box in the DLC tab in properties, which will remove the DLC and allow you to go back to WTNC itself. 

Again, HUGE apologies for this weird glitch, it's very frustrating for us to have to deal with this on release day but even more frustrating for those of you who were looking forward to playing. We'll be sure to post again once this is fixed. 

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Living Dead Girl: A When The Night Comes Tale
notes.notes:
We're really excited to announce that we'll be releasing a new mini-tale just in time for Halloween! 

Things that go bump in the night are nothing new to the town of Lunaris. It's time to get the gang back together and help a ghoul in need in this LGBTQ+ Visual Novel DLC. Step back into the shoes of the Hunter and investigate a haunting happening in the Lunarian woodland with your colleagues August and Piper and get some help from the resident creatures of the night in a mini-tale. 

You can check out the DLC page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2173950/When_The_Night_Comes__Living_Dead_Girl]HERE[/url].

Releasing October 28th! SEE YOU SOON!

notes.title: Pride Month Support
notes.notes:
June is rapidly approaching, so we're preparing for a month of celebration and making some fun memes to post throughout the month over on [url=https://www.twitter.com/lunarisgames_]Twitter[/url]! 

Every year at Lunaris Games since our founding in 2018 we've created a limited edition merch collection to celebrate Pride Month. We've donated over $3,000 over the years to various charities like the Marsha P. Johnson Institute and The Trevor Project. This year we’re donating *all of our proceeds to [b]Trans Lifeline[/b], a trans-led organization that connects trans people to the community, support, and resources they need to survive and thrive. 

You can pre-order the shirt or the print seen in our header here (or both as a set!) on our shop website [url=https://wtnc-game.myshopify.com/][b]here[/b][/url]. 

Pre-orders are open until June 3rd so be quick as this collection will not be sold again!

A huge thank you in advance for your support. 

[i]*all proceeds minus shipping and production costs.[/i]

notes.title: Gayming Awards Nomination: Best LGBTQ Indie Game!
notes.notes:
For the second year in a row, we got a Gayming Awards nomination! A huge thanks to anyone who voted for us, we're so, so happy and couldn't be in better company. The Gayming Awards are the first and only global award ceremony celebrating LGBTQ+ video gaming and queer geek culture with a mission to celebrate diversity and inclusivity globally within games and interactive media. They'll be broadcast live on Twitch on April 25th. 

Keep your fingers crossed for us! 

[i]Find out more at [url=gaymingmag.com]Gaymingmag.com[/url][/i]

notes.title: Nominate WTNC for Best LGBTQ Game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The Gayming Awards, presented by Twitch, returns for its second year in April 2022. With a mission to celebrate diversity and inclusivity globally within games and interactive media. We had the honor of being nominated for best LGBTQ Indie Game last year with our other title, Errant Kingdom. We didn't win, but just being included among some other INCREDIBLE indie titles who are putting queer representation out there in beautiful ways was such an honor, and also instrumental in getting a tiny team like ours always-needed attention. 

If you enjoyed When The Night Comes it would truly mean the world to us if you would spare a few minutes to [b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfo5tkLOSGDXrdFy38mDiSk30woifdu7wSJT9te1lq87TsBAQ/viewform]NOMINATE US[/url][/b]!
